## ShikshaLokam – Just-in-Time Classroom Support Web App

1. A lightweight, link-based web app that gives teachers real-time, context-aware pedagogical support, even in low or unreliable connectivity environments.  
2. Designed for offline-first use on mobile data, it enables chat and voice-based queries, instant teaching material access, and escalation to CRPs/ARPs via WhatsApp and email  
3. Teachers can ask doubts in any language (text or voice) and instantly access relevant teaching material, explanations, and classroom strategies drawn from official manuals and practice guidance  
4. All teacher queries and escalations are visible on a customised CRP/ARP web dashboard, enabling remote, asynchronous guidance and timely intervention when needed for the teacher & not when CRP/ARP is visiting  
5. (TBD) Teacher Prep \- Rural teachers teach multiple subjects & often have to quickly brush up on the subject

### **Core Features**

* **Just-in-Time Query Support (Text \+ Voice):** Teachers ask classroom doubts via chat or voice and receive immediate, context-relevant guidance mapped to official manuals and pedagogy practices.  
* **Offline-First Knowledge Access:** Core content and recent interactions are cached locally so the app works seamlessly during mobile data drops.  
* **Escalation & Broadcast (WhatsApp / Email):** One-tap escalation of unresolved classroom issues to CRPs/ARPs via WhatsApp and email, with full context (query, guidance shown, and voice input if used).  
* **Mentor Visibility Layer:** All teacher queries and escalations flow into a shared CRP/ARP system for asynchronous review and response.  
* (TBD) \- Make an AI mentor CRP/ARP tool that can answer questions like how exactly to teach fractions kids don't seem to get it  
* (TBD) \- Memory feature \- to remember context or not

### **Key Screens (2–3 only)**

* **Teacher Home / Chat Screen:** Single primary interface for asking text or voice queries and consuming bite-sized, actionable guidance.  
* **Escalation & Reference View:** Shows sourced excerpts from teacher manuals \+ option to escalate to CRP/ARP with prefilled context.  
* **CRP/ARP Dashboard:** Web view listing aggregated teacher queries, escalations, urgency signals, and response status.
